ja194:1.1: There are no Devas, they surely live far off,
ja194:1.2: Here are surely no guardians of the world.
ja194:1.4: There are surely none who can ward them off.
ja194:2.1: For him it rains out of season,
ja194:2.2: for him in season it rains not,
ja194:2.3: From his place in heaven he fell,
ja194:2.4: on that account he is slaughtered.
